raw_response:
A is ill-posed as a bridge back to Window6/Fibonacci. It is well-posed only as a Window6 self-diagnostic.
The decisive problem is that “first-order” is not an absolute concept. It is first-order relative to a product structure.
For codons, the product structure is canonical:

$$H(3,4)=V_4^3.$$

Its  $E_1$  layer means additive dependence on one of three codon positions, with each position carrying chemical base characters. That is why the certified localization to position 3, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine is meaningful. It says the residual is ordinary single-position codon chemistry.
For Window6, the natural carrier is different:

$$X_6=\{x\in\{0,1\}^6:\text{no adjacent 1s}\},\quad |X_6|=21,$$

inside the Boolean cube  $Q_6$ . Its natural spectral frames are Boolean Fourier degree on six binary coordinates, or the adjacency/Laplacian spectrum of the Fibonacci cube  $\Gamma_6$ . Boolean degree 1 means one bit. Codon  $E_1$  means one four-state codon position. These are not the same object.
You can compute a legitimate Window6 diagnostic:

$$f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64,$$


$$\rho_k(W)=
\frac{\sum_{|S|=k}\hat f_W(S)^2}
{\sum_{S\neq\varnothing}\hat f_W(S)^2},
\quad k=1,\ldots,6.$$

A fair null would be all  $21$ -vertex subsets of  $Q_6$  with internal edge count  $38$ , preferably also preserving the coordinate-marginal multiset. If Window6 is extreme for  $\rho_1$ ,  $\rho_2$ , or high-degree energy, that certifies a property of Window6 as a Boolean constraint.
But it does not certify a bridge to codon  $E_1$ . To compare them, you must group six Boolean bits into three pairs and declare those pairs to be codon-like  $V_4$  positions. That grouping is not forced by Window6. If selected because it makes the comparison attractive, it is convention-circular. If all 15 pairings give the same result, the result is generic to Window6, not a codon bridge. If only one pairing works, it is not label-free.
So A can only produce a negative-control appendix:
Window6 has its own Boolean spectral profile, but no canonical map identifies that profile with codon  $E_1$ .
That means the bridge is correctly bio-gated. There is no remaining pure-math or public-data step that can non-vacuously reconnect the certified codon  $E_1$  residual to Window6/Fibonacci. The structural program is genuinely exhausted as a bridge program.
The important result should be stated plainly: the hoped-for  $E_3$  spectral bridge failed. The real bio-intrinsic residual sits in first-order codon chemistry: wobble, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine. That is biologically plausible, but it is not a Fibonacci signature.
The sharpest next question is: In a larger held-out organism panel, does the certified codon- $E_1$  wobble/position-1 residual remain reproducible after tRNA-tAI, TE, clade, and composition controls, or is it only a codon-spelling artifact?
